content.value_statement: Frame-accurate Three.js rendering is hard when scenes depend on wall-clock animation. This skill shows HyperFrames patterns that render from hf-seek time.
actual_capabilities: Explains the HyperFrames three runtime adapter contract.
Shows how to render a scene from hf-seek time.
Provides a basic Three.js canvas setup pattern.
Shows AnimationMixer seeking for GLTF clips.
Lists validation commands for HyperFrames compositions.
Identifies render patterns that break deterministic output.
limitations: Does not include a complete production scene template.
Does not provide asset loading code for GLTF or textures.
Assumes users already know Three.js basics.
Uses one CDN import in the example.

use_cases.title: Create Product Spins
use_cases.description: Build repeatable Three.js object rotations that render the same frame for the same HyperFrames time.

use_cases.title: Validate WebGL Video Layers
use_cases.description: Check WebGL canvas layers for deterministic sizing, timing, and frame output before rendering video.

use_cases.title: Adapt GLTF Animation Clips
use_cases.description: Use AnimationMixer setTime patterns so authored clips follow HyperFrames seek events.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Timing Drift

prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Three.js HyperFrames scene and replace wall-clock animation with deterministic time-based rendering.

prompt_templates.prompt: Show how to drive multiple Three.js AnimationMixer instances from HyperFrames hf-seek events.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Render Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this HyperFrames Three.js composition for render-critical network loads, pixel ratio issues, and non-deterministic frame history.

output_examples.input: A scene rotates an object with requestAnimationFrame and elapsed clock deltas.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend deriving rotation from HyperFrames time and rendering only when hf-seek fires.

output_examples.input: A GLTF clip must match the exact rendered video frame.
output_examples.output: The skill would describe seeking each AnimationMixer to the requested time before rendering the scene.

output_examples.input: A WebGL layer changes with device pixel ratio during rendering.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend fixed renderer size and pixel ratio settings for stable video output.

best_practices: Load render-critical assets before validation or seeking begins.
Use HyperFrames time as the only source for render-critical motion.
Pin renderer dimensions and pixel ratio for video renders.
anti_patterns: Using Date.now or performance.now to update render-critical state.
Fetching remote models, textures, or HDRIs during seek events.
Depending on previous frame history without reconstructing state from time.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build deterministic Three.js and WebGL layers for HyperFrames compositions.

faq.question: Does it include a complete app?
faq.answer: No. It provides adapter patterns, timing guidance, and validation practices.

faq.question: How should animation time be handled?
faq.answer: Use the hf-seek event time instead of browser clock time.

faq.question: Can it support GLTF animation?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes using AnimationMixer setTime to seek authored clips.

faq.question: Does it require remote assets?
faq.answer: No. The guidance recommends loading local assets before render-critical seeking.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
